scripts.deploy:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const landing='dist/launch-plan/index.html';if(!fs.existsSync(landing)){console.error('✗ No '+landing+' — run pnpm build first.');process.exit(1);}const t=fs.readFileSync(landing,'utf8').match(/<title>([^<]+)<\/title>/);console.log('✓ '+landing+' title:',t?t[1]:'(none)');console.log('✓ cwd:',p.basename(process.cwd()));console.log('✓ public/_redirects:',fs.existsSync('public/_redirects')?fs.readFileSync('public/_redirects','utf8').trim():'(none)');"
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy:check && wrangler pages deploy dist
